book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.anguish_: This incense grants nearby mobs Strength while the Brazier burns. It requires 200 altar power to begin.
A Witches tool to burn ingredients with flint and steel, or a fire charge.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.censer.c: The Censer burns potions as incense, spreading their effects to all nearby. Right-click with any potion to add it to the censer. Effects continuously apply within a 16-block radius while the potion lasts.
Certain ingredients burn eternally when blessed by altar power. Soul fire particles indicate an active censer, with colored wisps showing the potion's nature.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.deathly_: This incense cloaks nearby mobs in Invisibility while the Brazier burns. It requires 200 altar power to begin.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.drain_gr: This incense drains nearby growing crops to heal injured living creatures around the Brazier. It requires 200 altar power to begin.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.fortific: This incense grants nearby mobs Resistance while the Brazier burns. It requires 200 altar power to begin.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.graveyar: A lingering brazier incense that spreads pale graveyard mist across the surrounding land. It requires 200 altar power to begin.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.name: brazier
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.potion.p: Burning potions with wooden ash is an easy way to make the effect linger. Not as portable as a Lingering potion, but far easier to get.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.summon.s: Burning a set of specific ingredients, we can call the dead to later bind to an effigy for unique, and maybe deadly, effects.
book.witchery.guidebook.brazier.summon_p: Burn this incense to call a Poltergeist. It requires 500 altar power.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.beginnin: Custom potions begin in a lit Cauldron with a nearby Altar. Start with Nether Wart, then add ingredients while watching the potion's Capacity and Altar Power costs.
Stronger ingredients consume more Altar Power. Plan the order of your ingredients before the brew is complete.
Build a potion one effect at a time
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.brew_of_: A brew that transforms blocks through the mod's erosion pairs, turning stone, soil, and other materials into their weathered forms.
Made only in the Spirit World. Throw it to create Flowing Spirit, which grants Regeneration to those who bathe in it. In that world, use it on adjacent double doors to create a Spirit Portal.
Chills creatures, extinguishes fire, and freezes nearby water into ice or lava into obsidian.
Blinds affected creatures; non-player creatures are also slowed while the darkness lingers.
A brew which stops damage being taken. All damage conbined will return when the effect runs out.
A living animal struck by the brew enters love mode, ready to breed with a suitable partner.
A brew that clears memories, removes hostile focus, and forgets Tarot cards from affected creatures. Use it when even magical grudges must be forgotten.
Throw it at a breakable block to destroy the block and raise a zombie, skeleton, or zombified piglin from the earth.
Removes Invisibility from affected creatures and reveals spectral creatures that would otherwise remain hidden.
Drink it to leave your body and enter the Spirit World through sleep. Dream Weavers, Wispy Cotton, and Flowing Spirit nearby improve the chance of a favourable dream.
Drink it to gain Water Breathing and Conduit Power for a time. The brew's magic is strongest beneath the surface.
A twisted brew that grants the Grotesque effect, reshaping the drinker's appearance and frightening villagers.
A lingering brew which drains the surroundings plants life and transforms it into health for the entities inside.
Withers living creatures and destroys plants in the affected area. A stronger brew reaches farther and spreads more widely.
Slows creatures with Weaving and creates cobwebs at the point of impact, with a chance to spread them nearby.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.brews.br: Brews are the primary creations of the cauldron. These magical mixtures can be consumed or thrown, granting various effects to those who use them. Master these recipes to harness their power.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.brews.de: Cauldron brews for body and spirit
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.cauldron: The Cauldron is the heart of every witch's workshop, used to brew potions, create magical brews, and craft witching wares. Fill it with water and ignite it with Flint & Steel before use. More powerful concoctions often require a nearby Altar. A pinch of Wood Ash will cleanse the Cauldron, allowing a new brew to be prepared.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.crystal_: Use it with Paper to create a Coven Contract. Use it with an empty hand to read your active curses and Tarot cards.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.flying_o: An oil of wind and wings. Use it in the proper ritual to imbue a broom with flight.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.ghost_of: A pale essence for the Infusion of Light
A pale ectoplasmic brew used in the Infusion of Light ritual. Its essence slips between the visible and unseen.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.hags_rin: In a finished Brew of Wasting, infuse a Hag's Ring: Lumber. Equip the ring and use it with a Witch's Hand to harvest connected logs at once.
In a finished Brew of Erosion, infuse a Hag's Ring: Miner. Equip the ring and use it with a Witch's Hand to harvest connected ores at once.
Reach farther with a Witch's Hand
In a finished Brew of Webs, infuse a Hag's Ring: Reacher. Equip it to extend your reach while using a Witch's Hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.happenst: An oil used in the Seer Stone ritual. It helps call a coven of witches to a golden ritual circle.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.infuse_s: Concentrated essences for rituals and advanced workings
Hold the Seer Stone near a golden ritual circle to summon a coven of witches.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.infusion: Concentrated essences for rituals and advanced workings
Infusions are concentrated magical essences that serve as components for more advanced rituals and crafting. Unlike brews, they are not meant to be consumed but used as ingredients.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.mystic_b: A branch prepared for symbol magic. Hold it in your hand and draw gestures to cast the symbols you have learned.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.mystic_u: A concentrated ungent used to imbue an Ent Twig with natural magic through ritual.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.name: Brewing
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.palevine: This ink has magical properties and can be used with a feather to draw sigils. Sigils can push mobs, ward against curses end more.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.potion_e: Choose how the potion is used
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.redstone: A versatile redstone base used to prepare several advanced infusions.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.soul_of_: An essence drawn from the Overworld and used in the Overworld Infusion ritual. It answers to stone, soil, and root.
book.witchery.guidebook.brewing.spirit_o: Enderman essence used in the Infusion of Otherwhere ritual. Once infused, a Witch's Hand can channel it to bend space.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.altar.al: The Altar is the source of Altar Power, which many contraptions and rituals require. As long as they are close to the Altar, they will be supplied with power. More nature around the Altar, such as trees and flowers, increases its Altar Power.

Up to 6 modifiers can be placed on the Altar. Heads provide a multiplier and a flat boost. Lights provide a multiplier. The Chalice provides a flat boost. Range modifiers increase the range of Altar Power. Special modifiers, such as the Pentacle, double power, while the Infinity Egg maximizes power.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.altar.ge: Place 6 blocks in a 3x1x2 arrangement to create the Altar multiblock.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.armor_pr: Right before your armor breaks it will be fully repaired.
A ritual blade used in witchcraft. Place it on an Altar for ritual use; its strikes can also draw Spectral Dust from slain undead.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.beginnin: All witchery begins with the green. Break thee the wild grass, and the earth shall gift thee seeds most curious and rare.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.cauldron: The Cauldron is the heart of every witch's workshop, used to brew potions, create magical brews, and craft witching wares. Fill it with water and ignite it with Flint & Steel before use. More powerful concoctions often require a nearby Altar. A pinch of Wood Ash will cleanse the Cauldron, allowing a new brew to be prepared.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.coven_co: Sign the Contract to gather a coven of players and witches. Joining a coven is no small commitment, and a witch may first demand a favor before pledging herself to your cause. As your coven grows in power, those seeking entry may become increasingly demanding. Keep the Contract safe, for destroying it disbands the coven.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.critter_:
Small Slimes, Bats and Silverfish will be trapped in this plant.
\
\
Require four Alder Saplings, Water, Cobweb and a Zombie.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.death_pr: A pocket heart transplant that sacrifices itself to save its owner from death once. Cannot be placed in the world.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.distille: Herein lies the art of separation. By fire's kiss and copper coils, one may draw forth the true essence of a mixture, layer by layer. The Distillery separates brews into their individual components, allowing them to be reused in new concoctions
book.witchery.guidebook.general.ender_br:
Hurts to the touch, teleports the toucher far away. \
\
Requires a Sugar Cane, Grasspers with 4 Ender Pearls, 4 Spanish Moss
book.witchery.guidebook.general.fume_ext: With a maximum of two, one on each side of the Oven, this will increase the output chance of Fumes
book.witchery.guidebook.general.grassper:
Can be used to hold items for rituals.
\
\
Require four grass, one chest and one water.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.hobgobli: Too many worshippers for a long time will call Mog and Gulg. A Nether Star or Eternal Catalyst will immediately call them.
They are found around their homes. Will mine for Koboldite Dust if equipped with a pickaxe and food, any stone or dust will be deposited in a chest neraby the mine, or shift right clicked on them.

Must be bound with a Ritual of Binding. Hobgoblins will pray att the statue giving boons to the player bound to it. A few Hobgoblins will charge the players infusion around the statue. More will grant larger Symbology grid and increse infusiuon recharge.
This pickaxe will speed up Hobgoblins a lot. The material also allows it to be passed through to the Spirit World.
Grants 2 Armor and infinite Arrows which deals more damage to targets in the air and inflict Slowness. Grants Resistance if close to a player with Gulg's Gurdle.
Grants 2 Armor and gives the ability to launch your opponent using an empty hand. Grants Resistance if close to a player with Mog's Quiver.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.hunger_p: Occasionally restores a small amount of hunger to its owner.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.mushroom: Create a Mushroom Log by placing two Dark Oak Logs side by side, holding a Moss Block in your main hand and a mushroom in your off-hand, then right-click one of the logs. The Mushroom Log will slowly grow that type of mushroom in dark conditions and can be harvested repeatedly once mature.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.mutandis: A concoction of evil scrambled eggs. Use it on plants to mutate them into other varieties. For a short time after use, Mutandis will only affect the same type of plant, allowing repeated use to cycle through its possible mutations. For example, repeatedly using it on a sapling will eventually transform it into different kinds of saplings.

An enhanced form of Mutandis, capable of altering growths and materials beyond ordinary mutation. It may affect wheat, cactus, and sugar cane, transform grass into mycelium, and turn submerged dirt into clay, while retaining all uses of regular Mutandis.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.mutating: A magical sprig infused with mutative magic. It can create Grasspers, Critter Snares, Wormwood, Parasitic Lice, and Owls, as well as transform certain blocks into other forms.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.name: General
book.witchery.guidebook.general.oven.ove: By fire and fume, the Oven transforms natural materials into magical Essences. Place Clay Jars to capture the escaping vapours, otherwise they will dissipate into the aether
book.witchery.guidebook.general.owl.name: Owl
Familiar, quite stupid but grants better control over broom when bound.
\
\
Require three Mutandis Extremis, one Charged Attuned Stone, Water, Wolf, Cobweb and one Critter snare with a bat for each Owl.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.parasiti:
Can be picked up, has the ability to store and apply a Potion. Use potion on louse to apply it. has a chance to consume the potion on attacking a creature.
\
\
Require Two Mutandis, One Tongue of Dog, one Charged Attuned Stone and one Critter Snare with a Silverfish. Water and Lily pads.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.poppet.p: Craft together with a Taglock to bind to a player or creature. If the poppet dont require to be in the owners inventory you can place it in the world.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.spinning: A magical workstation for spinning enchanted materials into magical threads and fabrics. Many recipes consume Altar Power.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.tag_lock: A Taglock captures the essence of an entity, creating a magical link used in many rituals.

It may also be collected from a bed that has recently been slept in. Taglocks expire after two days. Approaching your target from behind or while invisible greatly increases your chance of success, while attempting it in plain sight or bright light is much more likely to fail
book.witchery.guidebook.general.vampiric: Binds two living creatures together, redirecting most of the primary target's suffering to the secondary target. May be carried or placed in the world.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.voodoo_p: A poppet that inflicts harm upon its bound target. Throw it into water to drown, fire to burn, from great heights to injure, or use a needle to stab.
This poppet will save you from Voodoo
book.witchery.guidebook.general.waystone: Use a Waystone on a block to bind its location for teleportation and other distant rituals.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.werewolf: Raised from stone and bound with Wolfsbane.
book.witchery.guidebook.general.wild_bra:
Hurts to the touch, use golden tool to break without spreading.\
\
Requires a Cactus, Grasspers with 2 Blaze powder and 2 Bone meal, 4 Spanish Moss
book.witchery.guidebook.general.wormwood:
Used mostly in necromancy and brazier.
\
\
Require Wheat, four Wispy Cotton and Four Water.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.horn: The Horned Huntsman answers a Wicker Man built from Blood-Stained Hay. Ignite the finished figure with Flint and Steel to summon him nearby. Defeat him to prove yourself worthy of the next bloodline.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.moon: Wear the Moon Charm in a Curio slot to assume Wolf or Werewolf form. Removing it immediately returns you to your natural shape.

The Rite of Moonbinding empowers the charm. From the second bloodline onward, it grants Blood Scent: use the ability to reveal a path toward nearby living creatures, then use it again to dismiss the scent.
From the second bloodline, the Moon Charm grants two transformations. Wolf form is swift and subtle; Werewolf form is stronger and more fearsome. Both forms require the charm to remain worn.
Use the Rite of Moonbinding to empower a normal Moon Charm. It requires a Quartz Sphere filled with sunlight, a Drop of Luck, a Blizz Rod, Mutton, and a Gold Ingot.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.nigh: A Night Howl unsettles nearby living creatures, slowing them and breaking their focus on you. At night, howl from distant territories to mark them for the pack and advance your bloodline.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.pack: Call loyal wolves to your side for a short hunt. They arrive tamed and strengthened, then vanish when their time is spent. Werewolf form calls an additional wolf.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.spre: At the final bloodline, your Bite can infect other players with lycanthropy if the server has enabled its spread. Infected villagers can transform under a full moon after the infection has taken hold.
book.witchery.guidebook.lycanthropy.were: Trap a Werewolf in a Beartrap infront of the Altar, let it infect you.

At the first bloodline, the Bite lets you lunge at a foe. It wounds and slows the target, while restoring a little of your own health. At the final bloodline, it may also pass lycanthropy to another player when the server permits it.
From the second bloodline, the Moon Charm grants two transformations. Wolf form is swift and subtle; Werewolf form is stronger and more fearsome. Both forms require the charm to remain worn.
book.witchery.guidebook.name: Guidebook
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.apply_oin: Infuse the Broom with flying powers.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.apply_ung: Infuse the Twig with magic powers.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.befuddlem: This curse clouds the mind of your victim, causing confusion and nausea. Their movements become erratic and unpredictable as the curse disrupts their thoughts.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.bestial_c: Will summon a flock of exactly 10 random animals, with some exceptions.
The smell alone should call them...
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.bind_fami: Cats, Owls and Frogs. All with unique powers while bound. Cats amplify rites and curses. Owls increases Broom manoeuvrability. Frogs increase chance of extra brewed potions.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.bind_spec: Binds spectral creatures like Spectres, Banshees and Poltergeists to an Effigy, like a Scarecrow, Trent Effigy or Witch's Ladder.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.blocks_be: Will pull copper from the depths below, this will consume the copper below in a cylinder of the ritual circle.
Will pull gold from the depths below, this will consume the gold below in a cylinder of the ritual circle.
Will pull iron from the depths below, this will consume the iron below in a cylinder of the ritual circle.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.change_bi: Will Change the biome at ritual center or at waystone. A Diamond will increase the radius from 16 to 64.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.charge_at: Charges an attuned stone, this charge is required by some recipes and rituals, can also replace Altar Power up to 3000.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.corrupt_p: Twist a Voodoo Protection Poppet into a Corrupt Poppet. A familiar cat is needed to channel the rite.
Turn protection into a dark lure
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.curse_of_: This terrible curse summons manifestations of madness to haunt your victim. Entities born of insanity will periodically appear to torment them. Requires stormy weather to cast.
Bad luck follows those afflicted by this curse. They will be randomly struck by debilitating effects, making even simple tasks difficult. Cast during a storm for maximum potency.
Bring bad luck to your target
Those cursed with overheating will burst into flames when in hot biomes. The scorching heat of deserts, savannas, and the Nether becomes unbearable, igniting their very flesh.
Make your target burn in hot climates
Water becomes deadly for those afflicted with this curse. They will sink like stone, unable to swim to the surface. Best cast during a storm when the waters are already treacherous.
Make your target sink in water
Your skin burns hot when exposed to direct sunlight.
Under a full moon, curse the creature bound to a Taglock with lycanthropy. A familiar cat is required.
Awaken the beast within your target
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.curses.cu: Smite your enemies with curses, or they will curse you.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.fragility: Make your target vulnerable to harm
This curse weakens the body of your victim, making them brittle as glass. They will take significantly more damage from all sources.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.golden_ch: The center block in a ritual circle, surround with items either on ground or on a Grassper. Rightclick to activate the ritual
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.hunger.hu: A cruel curse that inflicts insatiable hunger upon your target. No matter how much they eat, they will never feel satisfied as their food depletes rapidly.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.infernal_: Infernal Chalk channels the power of the underworld.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.infuse_in: User can use abilities of the last entity it slays. Use with a Witches Hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.infuse_li: User can become invisible with a Witches Hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.infuse_ot: User can teleport with a Witches Hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.infuse_ov: User can move the earth with a Witches Hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.manifesta: Enables a player to walk through a spirit portal
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.mirror_pa: Bind a pair of demonic mirrors
Sacrifice a Demon to create two linked mirrors and their demonic contract.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.name: Ritual
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.necro_sto: A stone shaped from death and spectral essence
Perform this rite at night to create a Necromatic Stone from an Attuned Stone, bone, rotten flesh, Wood Ash, and Spectral Dust. It is used in rites concerning spectral creatures and manifestation.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.otherwher: Imbued with the essence of distant realms.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.pull_mobs: Draw nearby creatures to the circle
Draw nearby creatures toward the ritual circle while the rite is sustained.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.push_mobs: Mobs will be pushed away from the ritual center.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.raining_t: It will rain and it will frog, watch out for their poisonous skin, will only last for a minute or two.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.remove_cu: Lift the oldest curse from a target
Use a Taglock to lift the oldest curse affecting its bound target. The rite must be performed by day.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.resurrect: Call a fallen familiar back to life
Restore a dead familiar for a nearby witch.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rite_of_b: Through Viteomantic practice, empower the bloodstone pendant allowing it to tap directly into the wearer's Anima.
Requires a normal Bloodstone Pendant, a Drop of Luck, a Weak Blood Shard, a Blood Pearl, a Necromantic Stone, and a Nether Star.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rite_of_c: Replenishes the infused players power during the duration of the rite.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rite_of_s: Bind sunlight into a Sunstone Pendant, granting a vampire permanent protection from the sun while worn.
Requires a normal Sunstone Pendant, a Quartz Sphere filled with sunlight, a Drop of Luck, a Blaze Rod, Glowstone Dust, and a Gold Ingot.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.ritual_ch: The standard ritual chalk, no special alignment.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rot.descr: Spread decay through the ritual grounds
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rot.name: Rot
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.rot.rot.t: Corrupt nearby creatures, raw meat, crops, and flowers with a wave of decay.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.set_day.s: Forwards the time to next day.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.set_midni: Manipulate the celestial bodies to make day into night.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.summon_de: Summons a fierce Demon which will drop a Demon Heart, an incredibly valuable resource
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.summon_im: Trade souls for goods, souls in any form have to be close by for trading. Different souls have different value.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.summon_li: Call lightning to the ritual circle
Call down a bolt of lightning upon the ritual circle.
Call down a bolt of lightning at the bound Waystone.
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.summon_sp: Summons a Spectral Pig which will drop Spectral Dust, a valuable resource
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.summon_wi: Its the wither what can i say
book.witchery.guidebook.ritual.teleport_: Sends the user to the location of the waystone
Send a bound target to a Waystone
Send the entity bound to a Taglock to the bound Waystone.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.app: This cursed apple sends the eater directly into the Nightmare world. Unlike the Brew of Sleeping, it offers no chance of a favourable dream.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.bre: Can only be made in the Spirit World. Throw to make a fluid which applies regeneration to anyone bathing in it. Throw it on double doors in the Spirit World to make a Spirit Portal. Rite of Manifestation required to enter it

Drink this brew in the Overworld to leave your body behind and enter the Spirit World. A dream may lead to the peaceful Dream or the hostile Nightmare. Nearby Wispy Cotton, Flowing Spirit, and Dream Weavers of Nightmares improve the chance of a favourable dream.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.dis: This nightmare warps and twists the Wispy Cotton to become... Disturbed..
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.dre: Place Dream Weavers near where you drink a Brew of Sleeping. They help shape the dream to come and form the base for specialised Dream Weavers spun with the Spinning Wheel.
A strange brew for the soul, fasting in sleep will still the hunger within, leaving you calm when the dawn breaks
Swift as the wind, this spirit will carry you swiftly through the waking world, like a whisper in the breeze.
The iron arm of slumber. Rest as if your body were bound by steel, and awaken with unyielding strength.
Born of shadow and fear, this weaver binds nightmares into the night. May it grant you peace when the dark calls.
I have a Dream to one day bring my armor
Equip to be able to bring armor to the spirit world and back
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.hun: Kill your Nightmare to acquire, can be brought between dream and reality.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.icy: Harvest Icy Needles from mature Snowbells. Consume one in the Spirit World to return to your sleeping body, or in the Overworld to end a manifestation early.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.man: Walk briefly in the waking world

This rite lets a dreamer pass through a Spirit Portal and manifest in the Overworld. Manifestation lasts two minutes. Your equipment is dropped while manifested, and an Icy Needle is the only item carried through the portal.
Requires Spectral Dust, Mellifluous Hunger, a Necromatic Stone, an Arthana, and a Breeze Rod. The rite needs 5000 altar power and a Small Otherwhere ritual circle.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.nig: A hunter born from bad dreams

In the Nightmare world, a personal Nightmare stalks each dreamer. It appears nearby and returns after a time unless defeated. Slay it to claim Mellifluous Hunger and earn a brief respite from its pursuit.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.spi: In the Spirit World, place two doors side by side and use Brew of Flowing Spirit on them. The doors become a Spirit Portal. Only one who has completed the Rite of Manifestation can pass through it.
book.witchery.guidebook.spirit_world.wis: A delicate weave from the fabric of dreams. To hold it is to hold the softness of slumber itself
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.force_: Gently forces the target to back off.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.light_: Let there be no light, and give it to me
Shoots a projectile which breaks all light sources and sends them towards your.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.mend_f: Perform a small heal on yourself at the cost of food.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.name: Symbology
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.propul: Sends the caster flying, fall damage immunity once.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.snuff_: Breaks all light sources in close vicinity.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.thorn_: Applies small damage to the target.
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.water_: Great on a hot summer day
book.witchery.guidebook.symbology.wrest_: The target loses their grip and drops the item in hand.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.death.deat: Decay consumes you. Hunger drains constantly (0.5 exhaustion every 10 seconds). At nightfall, 15% chance Death itself manifests to claim your soul. This card expires upon summoning.
Transformation through endings. Kills on summonable creatures have 5% chance to raise them as 24-hour ethereal servants. Each dawn purges all negative effects. Death renews.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.death.name: Death
Past sins haunt relentlessly. Each kill inflicts 2 hearts of magical damage upon yourself. Blood guilt weighs heavy on the damned.

Rise from the ashes. When lethal damage strikes, 50% chance Judgement spares you at 1 health with Regeneration III, Fire Resistance, and Resistance II for 10 seconds. Kills restore 1 heart. Divine mercy is finite—this card expires after saving you.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.justice.ju: Injustice prevails cruelly. All damage you receive increases by 30% as the scales tip against you. Punishment comes swiftly and without mercy.
Perfect balance is maintained. When creatures damage you after you've struck them, they suffer 2 hearts of thorns damage. An eye for an eye brings karmic justice.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.name: Tarot
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.strength.s: Weakness pervades your limbs completely. Attack damage decreases by 1 heart as your power fades. The strong become feeble and powerless.
Devastating might flows through you. Attack damage increases by 3 hearts, and each kill restores 2 hearts of health. True strength encompasses both body and spirit.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.tarot_read: Divine your fortune with the cards

Right-click a Tarot Deck to perform a reading. Three cards will be drawn, revealing your fortune for the next three days. Each card brings powerful effects—both beneficial and perilous. A Crystal Ball reduces the chance of reversed cards appearing. Hold L.Alt to show active cards
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.temperance: Excess and imbalance plague all actions. Effects feel unstable and unpredictable. Moderation utterly fails.
Perfect balance restores harmony. When below half health, you slowly regenerate 0.5 hearts every 2 seconds. Water grants Water Breathing. Brews last longer. Moderation brings peace.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_chario: Your path is blocked at every turn. Movement speed decreases by 5% as if wading through deep mud. Each step becomes laborious torment.
Swift as the wind, unstoppable as a charging steed. Your movement speed increases by 10%, granting you the mobility to chase victory.
Breaking free from bondage. Every 30 seconds, all negative effects are cleansed, but you lose 5 experience levels with each purge. Freedom costs dearly.
Dark power demands sacrifice. Attack damage increases by 2 hearts, but max health decreases by 1 heart. Devastating strength comes at the cost of vitality.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_empero: Authority crumbles to dust. Each dawn strips away 10 experience levels as your power diminishes. Control slips through your fingers like sand.
Command and dominance flow through you. Each dawn grants 10 minutes of Resistance, and your strikes have a 15% chance to inflict Slowness II on enemies for 5 seconds.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_empres: The harvest fails utterly. Breaking crops has a 30% chance to destroy them entirely, yielding nothing. Nature withholds its gifts from unworthy hands.
Nature's bounty flows freely. Breaking crops has a 25% chance to yield extra drops, and each dawn restores 4 hunger points. The earth provides generously to those who nurture it.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_fool.t: Recklessness brings misfortune. You occasionally stumble on nothing, taking fall damage while grounded. All damage received increases by 20%. Each step risks painful consequence.
Fortune favors the bold. Random beneficial effects occasionally bless you (speed, jump, or luck), and all damage taken is reduced by 10%. Embrace new adventures without fear.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_hanged: You cannot let go of anything. Items refuse to leave your grasp—dropping and throwing becomes impossible. Complete attachment binds you.
Sacrifice brings purpose. Your fall speed decreases by 30% as you drift gently downward. Taking over 5 hearts of damage channels 100 altar power per heart to the nearest altar within 16 blocks.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_hermit: Loneliness becomes madness. When no other players are within 32 blocks, you lose 2 hearts of max health. Isolation drains your life force completely.
Wisdom blooms in isolation. When no other players are within 32 blocks, you gain 1 experience every 5 seconds as you contemplate existence's mysteries.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_hierop: Healing forsakes the unfaithful. Each dawn inflicts 2 hearts of magical damage as divine favor withdraws. The gods punish those who stray from their path.
Divine protection shields the faithful. Two absorption hearts manifest each dawn for 10 minutes, and sleeping fully restores your health. Sacred blessings guard you.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_high_p: Secrets remain hidden. Constant darkness clouds your vision, and mining occasionally drains experience (15% chance). The mysteries turn away from your gaze.

The veil lifts, revealing hidden truths. Perpetual night vision clarifies the darkness, and breaking blocks has a 5% chance to reveal nearby ores within 8 blocks through glowing particles and highlighting.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_lovers: Love corrupts into violence. Passive animals within 16 blocks turn hostile with 10% chance per second, attacking you and each other. Harmony shatters into bloody chaos.
Creatures are calmed by your harmonious presence. Passive animals within 8 blocks never panic, their fear dissolved by your peaceful aura.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_magici: Magic turns against you. Nearby altars lose 500 power each dawn as your control falters and power scatters to the winds.
Your magical prowess peaks. Nearby altars gain 1,000 power each dawn, and thrown brews have a 20% chance to return to your inventory, their magic preserved for reuse.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_moon.t: Harsh daylight overwhelms your senses. During daytime, 5% chance every 5 seconds to suffer 5 seconds of Blindness as clarity obscures truth.

Embrace the shadows completely. Perpetual night vision pierces darkness. Each nightfall grants 10 minutes of Speed II. At night, hostile mobs lose track of you (30% chance every 4 seconds). The moon blesses its children.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_star.t: Hope fades to despair. Constant hunger drains 0.5 exhaustion every 5 seconds as your guiding light dims. Stars fall from heaven.
Hope illuminates the darkness. At night under open sky, you slowly regenerate 0.5 hearts every 2 seconds. Each nightfall fully restores health and purges negative effects. Stars guide the faithful.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.the_sun.th: The sun scorches mercilessly. Under open sky during daytime, you accumulate sun exposure that deals 2 hearts of damage per second when the meter fills. Like vampires, you burn in sunlight. Shadows become sanctuary.

Radiant energy fills you completely. Each dawn brings full restoration of health, hunger, and saturation, plus Regeneration II and Strength for 1 minute. Daylight provides passive healing (0.5 hearts every 3 seconds). The sun's blessing is absolute.
Fear of change paralyzes completely. Upheaval never comes, but neither does growth. Stagnation festers in stillness.

Chaos incarnate awaits. Breaking blocks has 5% chance to trigger small explosions. Rarely (0.1% per tick), Baba Yaga manifests without warning. Catastrophic revelation strikes. This card expires upon summoning.
Scattered and incomplete. Every 30 seconds, a random debuff (Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, or Unluck) afflicts you for 10 seconds as harmony fractures. Wholeness eludes your grasp.

Everything exists in perfect harmony. Permanent Speed, Haste, Luck, and Regeneration flow through you. Each dawn brings 10 experience levels. Breaking blocks has 10% chance for bonus drops. Perfection achieved.
book.witchery.guidebook.tarot.wheel_of_f: Misfortune follows relentlessly. Permanent Unluck II decreases loot quality and success rates. The wheel turns mercilessly against you.

Fortune smiles brilliantly. Permanent Luck II increases loot quality. Kills have 10% chance to drop rare treasures (iron, emerald, gold, mutandis, or experience bottles) and 25% chance to double the mob's entire loot table.
\
Increased comfort will make all the difference. Use Bone Needle to stain wool
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.batwin: Wear this pendant in a Curio slot to greatly extend the duration of your vampire bat form.
Extend your time in bat form
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.blood_: Fill the Crucible with blood from a filled Bottle of Blood or Wine Glass. As a vampire, use it to restore your blood pool. Your Vampire Children can also return their harvest to a nearby Crucible at night.
When a living creature steps on a Blood Poppy, the flower captures its essence and harms it slightly. Use a Glass Bottle on the marked poppy to receive a Taglock bound to that creature.
Snare an essence in a flower
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.bloods: Craft this pendant with a Wine Glass filled with blood, then wear it in a Curio slot. It greatly increases a vampire's blood-drinking speed while worn.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.cage_1: Use a Cage to hold a living captive. Look at the captive through the Cage to drink their blood or transfix them without releasing them.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.cane.c: Can collect blood with each hit, stored in the cane to be drunk whenever.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.name: Vampirism
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.sun_co: Place in the sun and put a Quartz Sphere on it to collect the sunlight
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.sun_gr: Capture sunlight in a Quartz Sphere

Place a Quartz Sphere in a Sunlight Collector to fill it with sunlight. Hold use briefly, then release to throw the sphere as a Sun Grenade. Its burst burns nearby creatures and counts toward the vampire's trial of sunlight.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.sunsto: A brief refuge from the sun
Wear this pendant in a Curio slot to gain a short reprieve from sunlight. Its power can later be permanently bound through the Rite of Sunbinding in the Ritual section.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_1:
\
\
It is with some reluctance I commit these observations to paper, for what I have witnessed is not for the weak of mind. Instead, take my words as a warning.

\
\
...he was reminiscing over dinner this evening about his "birth", a demonic pact of sorts...
\
\
\
\
 ..butchering a chicken over a skull with an Arthana and holding a glass goblet to collect the blood is barbaric," I told him...

\
\
...apparently start of a long forgotten rite 
\
\
\
\
\
 ..night, open to the moon, chalk, candles and skull

\
\
\
\
...pouring the blood onto the skull... 
\
\
\
\
 ..mumbling about taking her to the underworld

\
\
...proving his worth to her... 
\
\
\
\
\
\
\
\
\
 ..that glass goblet again, could someone really drink such a thing? ...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_2:
\
\
...Today, or should I say this evening, he told me about his first kill...
\
\
\
\
 ...the thirst that first night, he said, was overwhelming, he had to fully sait hes hunger...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_3:
\
...he found he was able to transfix his victims...
\
\
\
... was now able to drink as he needed without others realizing, so long as he did not drain more than half...\
\
\
\
\
 ...did so, from five oblivious souls...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_4:
\
...strength was flowing into him, the more he drank, as the nights progressed, the stronger he became...
\
\
\
\
 ...it was on the forth night after his mastery of drinking that the world slowed down...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_5:
\
...his greatest foe, the sun, was ever present, tormenting and instantly deadly to him...
\
\
\
\
\
 ...became his obsession... ...found a way to collect sunlight and burnt himself with it ten times during the night...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_6:
\
\
...first walk in the sun after his rebirth brought him to bloody tears, he felt his blood burning, but no longer instantly...
\
\
\
\
 ...he needed more strength, and extinguishing creatures of pure fire was his solution... ...twenty died.
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_7:
\
...he could smash solid stone, but bound to the earth, however fast, he was still limited...
\
\
 ...he called in Her once more, repeating the rite of his rebirth...\
\
 ...gifted Her a flower, the color of the blood She so craves...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_8:
\
\
...he smiled, a rare event, when he told me of his first flight...
\
\
\
\
\
 ...he flew from village to village, until he knew the full extent of his domain, there was now nowhere he could not go...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vamp_9:
\
...the weak minded would now not only let him drink his fill, but would also follow like faithful hounds...
\
\
\
 ...horror of all horrors, he lured five of them to specially prepared iron cages, topped with wood and with a gap at the front. He sealed them inside...

\
\
\
...he began feeding from each of them; mesmerising them first, then carefully he drank al he could without damaging any...\

At last he knew his blood was strong enough to replicate what She had done for him... ...left me weak, close to oblivion but I watched him fill a glass goblet and hand it to me... ...we both sat next to a coffin, far from the sun's gaze, "drink" is all he said...
book.witchery.guidebook.vampirism.vampir: Servants who hunt beneath the moon

At the ninth bloodline, mesmerize a villager and drink until they have no more than half their blood remaining. Then use a Wine Glass filled with your vampire blood on them to create your child. At night, a child may hunt and return with blood, restoring itself and depositing the remainder in its Blood Crucible. A master of the ninth bloodline also receives part of the harvest.
